title: UPPErrorResponse
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 error response format for UPP operations. Includes both standard JSON-RPC error codes (-32700 to -32603) and UPP-specific error codes (-32001 to -32099).

id.description: Request identifier. Matches the id from the corresponding request.

code.description: A number indicating the error type. Standard JSON-RPC codes: -32700 (Parse error), -32600 (Invalid Request), -32601 (Method not found), -32602 (Invalid params), -32603 (Internal error). UPP-specific codes: -32001 (User not found), -32002 (Ontology not found), -32003 (Store failed), -32004 (Extraction failed). Implementations may define additional codes in the range -32000 to -32099.

message.description: A short, human-readable description of the error.

data.description: Additional structured data about the error. Implementation-specific. Servers SHOULD include relevant context to aid debugging. Servers MUST NOT include sensitive user data.

error.description: Error object following the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification.
